text:
What is the advantage of connecting lamps in parallel in a lighting circuit?
A
A smaller fuse is needed to protect the lamps.
B
If the filament of one lamp breaks, the remaining lamps stay lit.
C
The current taken from the supply is less.
D
The lamps use less power.

options.label: A
options.text: A smaller fuse is needed to protect the lamps.

options.label: B
options.text: If the filament of one lamp breaks, the remaining lamps stay lit.

options.label: C
options.text: The current taken from the supply is less.
